Installed Q would violate pin/non-pin exclusion; detach(H) before tapping would break the retained core. Neither is a repair within this proposal.

attack.failure: The actual insertion supplies an observation with no action contingent on its value. Received replay establishes mechanical feasibility, not a useful unfamiliar connection. The matched-timing control predicts the same behavior with one fewer action; Q installation or H detachment would conceal an incompatible interface rather than repair it.
attack.invariant: Initially aligned panels retain at least 4 units at ticks 3-6, then separate with every installed retainer removed by boundary 10; no damage, discard, substitution, or outside resource.
attack.permitted_variable: Timing of supported actions and an available measurement of Q; theta is an observed unknown, not a free design variable. No useful Q-dependent opening is supported for this retained two-pin proposal.

handoff.summary: Stable boundary: intact H with assembled M/S installs P1/P2; pins alone provide 2+2 units. Required function stays 4 units at ticks 3-6 and complete release by boundary 10, without damage/discard/substitution/outside resources. Known K1: tap P1@0, tap P2@1, pull P1@7, pull P2@8. Received insertion I1: measure Q@0, tap P1@1, tap P2@2, same pulls. Matched control M1: tap P1@1, tap P2@2, same pulls, no measurement. All actions complete next boundary; one operator/action per tick, no double occupancy, intact H for taps, no non-pin retainer with pins. Mismatch: I1 calls Q information a scheduling link, but neither theta value changes actions; only measurement labor delays preparation. Available variables are action timing and reading Q. Q theta remains unknown until measurement, and measure adds no capacity. Supplied root replay has theta=4; theta=0 equivalence is analytical. One separating test: replay I1 and M1 and compare holding, release, impacts, actions, and both allowed theta branches; expect identical holding/release/impacts with one extra I1 action. Retain source-bound no-opening: no supported useful single-link insertion was found in the actual received proposal. Refuse originality, improvement, general impossibility, physical validation, or core replacement as an AC10 repair.
handoff.residue: The original K1 reaches full retention one boundary earlier than I1/M1; the matched control separates this timing difference from the unnecessary measurement. Root replay covers the reported theta=4 observation, not an empirical distribution or independently replayed theta=0 branch.
